test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Average of first ‘ N ’ odd natural numbers is 27 . What is the value of ‘ N ’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average of first N odd natural numbers = N

Given, Average = 27

⇒ N = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average of first N odd natural numbers = 27

**Formula:** Sum of an AP = (n ÷ 2) × [2a + (n − 1)d]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64ec82945d54974a914a53e229c3e429fc404b186d34b6c755a45a5eb4294621.png] 

⇒ First odd natural number (a) = 1

⇒ Common difference (d) = 2

⇒ Sum of first N odd numbers = (N ÷ 2) × [2(1) + (N − 1)2]

⇒ Sum = (N ÷ 2) × [2 + 2N − 2] = (N ÷ 2) × 2N = N²

⇒ Average = Sum ÷ N = N² ÷ N = N

⇒ Given N = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of first n natural numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers is given by the formula (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of first n even natural numbers

The average of the first n even natural numbers is always (n + 1).

Sum of squares of first n natural numbers

The sum is given by [n(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6.
